# However two important caveats bear on its use as a Kinsel anchor:
#   (1) RM-10 has a PARABOLIC BOATTAILED base (A_base / A_frontal = 0.367
#       base-diameter / body-diameter = 0.606
#       ~7 deg over the aft length).  Kinsel has a FLAT CYLINDRICAL fin-can
#       base (A_base = A_frontal).  Viswanath and Love show boattailing
#       reduces |Pb| by roughly 0.03 at M ~ 2-3 vs a flat base.
#   (2) Four 60-deg-sweptback fins sit AT the very base station
#       fin trailing edge roughly coincident with the base.  Love Fig 30/32
#       shows this fin placement gives a Pb that is NEAR the no-fin value
#       at M = 2.41 (Pb_finned ~ -0.14 vs Pb_nofin Fig 21 ~ -0.135).
